images.name: lars-did-you-know-were-all-going-to-die
images.joke: Lars, did you know we're all going to die?
images.alt: A girl in a Halloween costume and a small boy in an orange coat walk a dirt road through a new housing development at sunset; cartoon Gravel God stands beside them, hands on hips, and the girl's speech bubble reads: "Lars, did you know we're all going to die?"
images.note: He wears his tee and jorts, not the black suit.

images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God stands hands on hips beside a huge woodpile, with "2023" in glowing red neon numerals on the stump in front of him.
images.note: The rig has no axe: he stands by the woodpile instead of splitting logs.

images.joke: DNF? DFL? How do I get slower?
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, arms crossed and one eyebrow up, in front of a chalkboard, with a thought bubble: "DNF? DFL? How do I get slower?"

images.name: lars-did-you-know-were-all-going-to-die-3
images.alt: Two step charts of level against year, with cartoon Gravel God standing on the last step of each. Left: from level 1 the steps go up to 2, down to 1, and up to 2 over three years, and he winces. Right: they climb 2, 3, 4, and he gives a thumbs up.

images.name: untitled-design-2
images.alt: A grey, surreal image of a human figure built entirely of clock faces, with clocks breaking off and floating away from its shoulder, beside cartoon Gravel God in profile.
images.note: He is in full colour, not a faded grey ghost behind the scene.
